issues.title: Multiplayer: non-host cannot reliably damage enemies or take enemy damage
issues.author: momo1212221
issues.body:
Summary
In Multiplayer 0.7.3, enemy damage/death appears to be host-authoritative in a way that prevents the non-host player from reliably killing enemies.
The symptom follows the host role:

Player A hosts -> Player A can kill enemies, Player B cannot.
Player B hosts -> Player B can kill enemies, Player A cannot.

So this does not look platform-specific.
Environment

OpenRAC: 1.0.2, commit 9fc860d5
Multiplayer mod: 0.7.3
Game: Ratchet & Clank 1 PAL
Server: game.openrac.dev:7770
Host tested on…

issues.title: Index: approved mods remain unpublished after cooldown because hourly schedule stops running
issues.author: momo1212221
issues.body:
Summary
The signed public mod index is stale after the 24-hour cooldown for two already-approved external native mods.
Both modern-controls 0.3.0 and steam-deck-pack 0.3.0 are approved and present in the source index, but they are still missing from the published index.json / website because no scheduled index.yml run has occurred since their cooldowns expired.
